title: Arrays and Typed Arrays Check
description: Recall array op costs and when TypedArray fits.

questions.explanation: `shift` / `unshift` at the front are `O(n)` because they reindex. Prefer end operations or a better queue structure.

questions.prompt: Expected cost of reading `arr[i]` on a dense array is:
questions.explanation: Read/write `arr[i]` is expected `O(1)` random access by index.

questions.prompt: When should you prefer a `TypedArray` like `Uint8Array`?

options.text: For mixed objects and everyday algorithm practice
For fixed-width numeric buffers and binary / WASM data

questions.explanation: Use `TypedArray` for fixed numeric width, views over `ArrayBuffer`, and binary / Web API / buffer work. Prefer plain `Array` for mixed values.

questions.prompt: Spreading a typed array into a normal array (`[...typed]`) typically:

options.text: Shares the same buffer with `O(1)` cost
Changes the typed array’s fixed length

questions.explanation: Spreading a typed array into a normal array copies — `O(n)` time and space.
